item.title: Iran deal presents political nightmare for Netanyahu
item.description: Donald Trump's ceasefire agreement with Iran leaves the Israeli PM trapped in a new political and security dilemma.

item.title: Somaliland opens Jerusalem embassy after Israel's recognition of its independence
item.description: The move comes six months after Israel became the first country to recognise the breakaway East African state.

item.title: Australia to probe assault claims by Gaza flotilla activists against Israeli forces
item.description: Australian activists claim they were kidnapped, raped and tortured after being detained in May.

item.title: Fragile quiet in Lebanon as US-Iran truce leaves unanswered questions
item.description: Many Lebanese remain doubtful that the agreement could finally mean the end of the fighting between Israel and Hezbollah.

item.title: FBI thwarted plot targeting White House UFC event, Patel says
item.description: In newly unsealed court documents, the government alleges that the plan would have used drones. The FBI boss says multiple suspects are in custody.

item.title: Three reasons ships are not going through the Strait of Hormuz yet
item.description: Experts say that there are significant obstacles preventing traffic from returning to the levels seen before the conflict began – security, mines and tolls.

item.title: UK investigating reports Russian warship fired warning shots near yacht in English Channel
item.description: BBC News understands the yacht had drifted towards the Admiral Grigorovich, a Russian frigate which has been operating in the Channel.
